newsitem.title: UK: BFI up three as South Atlantic remains firm.
newsitem.headline: BFI up three as South Atlantic remains firm.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was up three points on Friday to 1,275 points and brokers reported continuing firm conditions in Argentina and Brazil.
Cargill were said to have fixed Samsun for about 50/55,000 grains 53ft Plate and Brazil to Continent for end May at $19.00 basis two to one.
Elsewhere conditions for Handy-sizes and Panamaxes were at least steady and in places firmer.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was between five and twenty points higher and turnover totalled 36 lots.
